text_block_list.text: Having quickly finished our errands, as we were discussing what to do next...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Would you like to go on a spontaneous trip?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have rarely ever acted without a plan before, so...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to try it someday
to broaden my own world, too.
...So, if you wouldn't mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
W-We really did end up coming here, didn't we?
A leisurely train ride to a town we know nothing about...
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah... What should we do next...!?
Y-yeah... What should I do after this...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
For now, shall we try walking along the path?
Hopefully we can find something...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: This place is...
choice_data_list: It's a small shrine, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Since we're here anyway,
shall we go offer a prayer?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (May this journey help me grow in at least one way.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm here, I'll buy an amulet...
—Oh? What's this notebook here?

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
This is a "goshuincho" stamp book
exclusive to this shrine.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Our shrine offers goshuin stamps.
Many visitors take them as keepsakes from their travels.
choice_data_list: A souvenir from a journey? Sounds lovely.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Then, may I have this one as well? I'd like a temple stamp along with it, please.
After leaving the shrine, we were looking for a place to eat in the shopping street in front of the station when...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Could it be Messiah-chan?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The hell are you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
W-What a surprise.
To think I would run into you in a place like this...
Actually, right now—
(Grumble...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Were you about to have a meal as well?
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...It's delicious.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it really hits the spot...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's after mustering all your courage, after all.
I'm sure it'll taste extra specialâª

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Still, a 'wandering journey', huh~?
...What a wonderful challenge!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...I'm really glad I tried it after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Getting to see back alleys like the ones in manga with my own eyes, and stuff...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I was too scared to go in there,
but instead, I found a quirky little general store.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"To enjoy such delicious ramen
at a cozy, hideaway-like shop."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't summoned up the courage to try,
I surely would have gone my whole life never knowing.
choice_data_list: I'm glad we went on that "little wander."
I'm glad we went on that "little wander."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...No.
"A wandering journey"? Seriously...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This is just two stops away.
It's well within walking distance from the academy.
choice_data_list: That was plenty of an adventure!
L-Let's go somewhere a little further away next time...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah.
What pushovers.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... But next time,
I'll try going even further.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Since I took the trouble to get a stamp book and all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Next...
choice_data_list: Ah, sorry for doing it on my own!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... No, I'm happy.
I had so much fun today, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let us go again.
Seeing as we received a Goshuincho stamp book and all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, a goshuincho?
How wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "I've been collecting them too! 'Autographs from ramen shops'♪"
choice_data_list: An autograph from the ramen shop?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I get them from the shop owners!
That way, I can always look back on the memories of eating there♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Then, I'll try collecting goshuin stamps too.
As proof of visiting the shrines during my travels.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
We can't let them beat us either, Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Do whatever you want. Just don't drag me into it.
